description: Universal model tier, reasoning budget, and execution mode mapping across Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and custom LLM environments.

multi_agent.description: Isolated parallel subagents via platform API (Antigravity invoke_subagent). Each role executes in its own isolated context with allocated model tier.

sequential_persona.description: Single-agent sequential persona switching with prompt-modulated thinking budgets. Used in GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or single-model environments where subagent forking is unavailable.

tier_1_deep_reasoning.prompt_directive: Act as [ROLE]. Activate deep extended reasoning. Exhaustively evaluate architectural invariants, failure modes, and edge cases before outputting solutions.

tier_2_analytical.prompt_directive: Act as [ROLE]. Perform systematic structural and UX analysis with focused analytical reasoning.

tier_3_balanced.prompt_directive: Act as [ROLE]. Implement clean, maintainable, and strictly specified code or tests adhering directly to Clean Architecture without speculative over-reasoning.

tier_4_fast_deterministic.prompt_directive: Act as [ROLE]. Execute deterministically and rapidly. Output strictly the requested command, commit message, or manifest with zero conversational overhead.
